scope: Android compatibility fix for legacy empty staging locks found during physical-phone clean-exit acceptance

fix.accept: Only empty regular resume.json.lock files without a symbolic link
fix.preserve: The legacy lock inode is not removed
fix.reject: Nonempty locks, symbolic links and unowned payload/resume files

added_cases: Empty legacy lock does not block cleanup and remains on disk
Nonempty lock or payload beside an empty lock still blocks cleanup
A symbolic link to an empty file is not accepted as a regular empty lock

physical_retest.linux_receiver: Real CLI transfers; explicit fixture-only manual state retirement with backup, original/hash/history preservation and independent API acknowledgement
physical_retest.stale_cli_receiver: Rejected at revoked-pairing gate before opening local state

failed_attempts: ADB connection disappeared before update; reconnected and exact device identity verified

Fixture retirement assertion expected local retired-state error, but CLI correctly rejected revoked pairing earlier; no receiver acknowledgement was sent until the assertion and preservation checks were corrected
limitations: This is a targeted compatibility and exit retest, not a full release qualification
Linux desktop GUI exit was not exercised against this physical phone; its core cleanup received separate integration tests
Source files and private recovery evidence are intentionally retained
No production relay deployment, installed Linux application replacement, commit or push
